title: Divide-and-Conquer Meets Consensus: Unleashing the Power of Functions in Code Generation

layout.note: A wide light-grey frame holds the left-to-right flow with the title card overlapping its top-left corner; below it two framed boxes side by side, a small Legends key on the left and a wide Example strip of six trees on the right.

lesson: Give one object three states by outline style (dashed, solid, filled), define them once in a small legend, reuse the coding on every card and again in a snapshot strip, so a recursive method can be read at both the flow level and the toy-example level.
